author: Kusha N M
raw:
ಸೋಲಿಸುತ ಗೆಲಿಸುವನು ಗೆಲುವಛಲ ತುಂಬಿಸುವ
ಮಾಲಿಕನು ಅವನೆಂದು ನಿನ್ನ ಜೀವನಕೆ
ಕೀಲಿಕೈಯನು ಹಿಡಿದು ಗೊಂಬೆಯಂತಾಡಿಸುವ
ಸೋಲೆ ನಿನ ಬಿಡುವನೇ ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: He defeats you to make you win; he fills you with the will to win;
he is the master of your life for ever;
holding the key, he makes you dance like a toy;
will he leave you in defeat, O deluded one?
en.bhavartha: The Divine sometimes lets us lose so that we may learn to win, and fills us with determination. The one who moves us like a puppet will not leave us defeated.
